IMPORTANT PUBLIC HEALTH AND SAFETY MESSAGE REGARDING PARTICIPATION AT CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
As a result of the COVID-19 emergency, and resulting orders and direction from the President of the United States, the Governor of the State of California, and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health, as well as the City of Palmdale emergency declaration, the public will not be permitted to physically attend the City Council meeting. Councilmembers may choose to participate via conference call.
How to Observe the Meeting:
1) Spectrum local access Channel 27
2) Online live webcast at cityofpalmdale.org.
How to Submit Public Comments through Palmdale eComments on this Agenda:
Note: Public Comments submitted will become part of the official meeting record.
1)Go to the Agendas & Minutes webpage at https://cityofpalmdale.org/310/City-Council-Meetings and find this meeting under Upcoming Events; 2) Click on the eComment button; and 3) Scroll through the agenda to find the agenda item for which you would like to provide a comment and submit your comment.
Please note: The City Council is making every effort to follow the spirit and intent of the Brown Act and other applicable laws regulating the conduct of public meetings in order to maximize transparency and public access.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 72 hours prior to the meeting.
1. CALL TO ORDER CLOSED SESSION MEETING.
2. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM LOA, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND BISHOP
3. PUBLIC COMMENTS RECEIVED ON CLOSED SESSION ITEM 4.1 THROUGH 4.3.
4. PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY of the following item to be discussed in Closed Session:
4.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel regarding the following pending litigation to which the City is a party:
Special District Risk Management Authority v. City of Palmdale, et al.
Sacramento County Superior Court
Case No. 34-2020-00280343
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54956.9(a) and 54956.9(d)(1).
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits and weaknesses of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public.
4.2 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel regarding the following pending litigation to which the City is a party:
City of Palmdale, et al. v. Westwind Enterprises LLC, et al.
Los Angeles County Superior Court
Case No. 19AVCV00653
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54956.9(a) and 54956.9(d)(1).
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits and weaknesses of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public.
4.3 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel and to receive direction from the City Council regarding the possible initiation of litigation by the City.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL--ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
Initiation of litigation pursuant to paragraph (4) of subdivision
(d) of Section 54956.9: Number of cases - One.
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public or to disclose further the circumstances in this potential case; such disclosure may harm settlement attempts or other efforts to resolve the matter without litigation.
5. CLOSED SESSION.
6. ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
7. ADJOURN CLOSED SESSION MEETING.

22.1 VARIOUS COMMITTEE MEMBERSHIPS:
Committee Membership Memo(s) on file in the City Clerk's Office:
Councilmember Bettencourt
Councilmember Carrillo
Councilmember Bishop
* ANTELOPE VALLEY AIR QUALITY MANAGEMENT DISTRICT - Councilmember Bishop stated that he filed his report with the City Clerk's office. He spoke regarding the grants being awarded to local businesses by the AVAQMD to help with replacing older equipment like diesel trucks and tractors. Mayor Hofbauer spoke regarding recently awarded grants.
* ANTELOPE VALLEY TRANSIT AUTHORITY - Mayor Pro Tem Loa attended the meeting on August 25th via Zoom. He stated that the Authority approved the employee wellness center; a solar purchase agreement; and discussed the decline in ridership. Mayor Pro Tem Loa stated that the AVTA is committed to adding more electric buses to their fleet.
* CALIFORNIA CONTRACT CITIES ASSOCIATION - Mayor Hofbauer attended several meetings regarding legislative items.
* CITY OF PALMDALE AUDIT COMMITTEE - No Meeting.
* CITY OF PALMDALE INVESTMENT OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE - No Meeting.
* HIGH DESERT CORRIDOR JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY - Mayor Hofbauer attended a brief meeting to discuss upcoming funding opportunities at Metro.
* LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES - Mayor Pro Tem Loa attended.
* LOS ANGELES COUNTY SANITATION DISTRICT - No Meeting.
* NORTH LOS ANGELES COUNTY TRANSPORTATION COALITION - Mayor Hofbauer attended a meeting regarding funding.
* PALMDALE RECYCLED WATER AUTHORITY - Councilmember Carrillo attended the meeting. He stated that the PRWA decided on a logo and discussed the grant process for Phase 2. City Manager Murphy spoke regarding a recent meeting with Palmdale Water District staff. He stated they discussed supplemental funding that might make Phase 2 a more plausible project. The direction moving forward is to encourage the Palmdale Recycled Water Authority to accept the current grant and at the same time apply for two additional grants. One from the State Water Resource Board, the other grant would be to help with the conversion of the Landscape Maintenance Assessment Districts and parks. Councilmember Bettencourt spoke regarding Phase 2 bringing recycled treated water to schools, parks, and city properties.
* SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA ASSOCIATION OF GOVERNMENTS REGIONAL COUNCIL - Mayor Hofbauer spoke regarding SCAG meetings
* UNITED STATES/MEXICO SISTER CITIES ASSOCIATION - No Meeting
* CALIFORNIA STATE PRISON – LOS ANGELES COUNTY, CITIZENS ADVISORY COMMITTEE - No Meeting
